M03.headline: Robot, terrain, and contact — one engineered scene.
M03.body: Use one source-grounded Go2 frame from a recorded evaluation run, a terrain profile, and restrained contact overlays. The caption must name the policy (NVIDIA checkpoint or foothold-v2), the terrain, and the run the frame came from.
M03.sourceNote: PENDING · Recorded foothold-v2 terrain clips with capture metadata exist in the private project repository. No frame has been chosen, provenance-recorded in this repository, or cleared for public brand use.

M04.headline: Track A closes in simulation. Track B moves the real Go2 on its stock gait.
M04.note: Decided 2026-10-12: the FOOTHOLD RL policy is not deployed to the physical Go2. Track A is completed in simulation; Track B runs the stock gait with SLAM and Nav2.

M06.disclaimer: SIMULATION ONLY · Isaac Lab · eval spec 2 · difficulty 0.5 · seed 42 · success requires survival, progress, tracking, and direction to all pass. Each terrain's 100 episodes share one terrain tile (100 starts, not 100 terrains). gap and rails are left out of the eight because training touched them. foothold-v2 over foothold-v1 (+1.75 %p) is the same size as seed-to-seed variation and is not claimed.
